note: The release plan for the Product & Program page. Milestones hold stories, stories hold an estimate in days of work, and every date on the page is computed from what is still outstanding — nothing here is a hand-typed date (the CEO's ruling, 2026-09-04). Releases run in the order listed; each one's estimated date is the previous one's plus its own remaining work. A release with unestimated stories has no date, and neither does anything after it, because a chain built on a guess is worse than an honest blank. Seeded 2026-09-05: v0.2.0's stories are the real remaining requirements of its two critical projects; everything after it is a placeholder waiting to be sketched with the CEO.

releases.name: Player Update 1

stories.title: One unprompted first session by an adult who has never played, on the tablet
Score the sleeping-cot bar from that session's trace: at least one sleep, unprompted
Confirm no regression on the standing bars — dead taps at or under 12%, longest stall at or under 16.3 seconds
Record the session and verify it replays to its own autosave
Write the release notes a player will read
Play the web build end to end before the tag goes out — only a person in a browser can tell you the sound arrives after the first tap
Cut the v0.2.0 tag from a green main through the deploy runbook
Bring the store page up to date with what this release adds
A ripe crop is obvious at a glance
stories.why: From play, 2026-09-07: nothing on the farm says loudly enough that a plant is ready to pick. The state exists in the sim and the crop's fourth cell draws it, but the reading is a small change of picture on a busy field — she has to go looking. Wants a treatment that carries across a whole plot at the altitude the teaching mode now uses, without words (S-7). Built 2026-09-07 and waiting on the designer: three treatments ride along in the build and are switchable on the tablet — the ripe ones nod, the ripe ones stand up, or the ripe ones give off their own colour — with today's game as the fourth position. The pick is a taste call and is asked as Q-94, with two look sheets staged in the real game: the same plot from the ground and from the height the camera rises to when she is directing a robot. Stays open until he names one, because the shipped default is still today's game.

stories.title: Fix the bed outline left over from the cot moving indoors
stories.why: Reported from play 2026-09-07 — "at nighttime, when all of your energy is spent, look at the house from the outside". The dusk cue lights the tile the next tap should land on, and it always drew the bed's own 16x32 footprint: on the 16x16 front door that spilled onto the wall above, so the house wore a bed outline every evening. Fixed the same day — the shape is now a pure function in `CotPresentation` and asserted, rather than inline geometry nobody could test.
